annotations.title: Verify legal citations in a text

description: CHECK A DRAFT BEFORE IT GOES OUT. Paste any text that cites Romanian law — your own draft, a client's contract, an opinion someone else wrote — and every article reference in it, down to the alineat, letter or point, is checked against the corpus. Each reference comes back as one of: ÎN VIGOARE (with the date it was last amended), ABROGAT, ARTICOL INEXISTENT (the act is real but has no such article — a fabricated citation), SUBDIVIZIUNE INEXISTENTĂ (the article is real but not the alineat, letter or point cited), or NEVERIFICAT (could not be checked, which is NOT the same as correct). A mention whose act cannot be read is listed as NEVERIFICAT, not skipped. RUN THIS ON ANY LEGAL TEXT YOU PRODUCE: article numbers move, articles are repealed, and a citation that was right when you learned it may not be right today. Extraction is deterministic — no guessing about which references exist.

text.description: The text to check. Romanian legal prose citing articles, e.g. 'potrivit art. 1357 din Codul civil ...'. Up to 20000 characters.
